title: Restrict verified populations for explicit intersection comparisons

context.use: Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.

outcome: Intersection comparisons recompute the same paired rows and retain original artifact-wide signal availability.
interfaces: Validated restriction accepts existing IDs only, borrows/owns payload once, and retains task/vocabulary/provenance/policy.
No synthetic prediction file or re-decoding shortcut is allowed for restriction.
Compared and both excluded ID lists/counts are deterministic and explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Default mismatched selections reject; --intersection accepts only same golden/task/roles/semantics.
Empty intersections distinguish probability/probability, label/label, and mixed availability independently for each side and each task.
No_data/not_applicable produce null deltas with reason; targeted results make no full-population improvement claim.

verification.expected: Metrics computed on shared IDs, not original aggregate results.
All availability combinations preserve exact statuses and null deltas.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
